collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A teenager shows the elders a new way to tie thatch that seems faster, and most elders dismiss it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a teenager, shows the elders a new way to tie thatch that seems faster, and most elders dismiss it.

choices.label: Ask the Teenager to Explain It Slowly.
Test Both Methods Side by Side.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The method is faster but less sturdy, and they agree to use it only for small huts.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The explanation is confusing, so the teenager simply demonstrates again.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The new roof leaks in one corner, and the teenager fixes it without discouragement.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The praise is welcome, but the teenager wanted the method used, and says so; the elder agrees to try it.

a1__fx.text: The elder finds it faster and says so in front of everyone.
